preconditions.description: The input contains at least one line.
The first line is an integer t between 1 and 100, and the number of subsequent lines equals t.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(line) <= 100 and all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in line) for line in stdin.strip().splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each test case string consists only of lowercase Latin letters and has a length between 1 and 100 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly one line for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all((line.lower() == 'yes' and (len(s) % 2 == 0 and s[:len(s)//2] == s[len(s)//2:])) or (line.lower() == 'no' and (len(s) % 2 != 0 or s[:len(s)//2] != s[len(s)//2:])) for line, s in zip(stdout.strip().splitlines(), stdin.strip().splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: For each test case string s, the output is 'YES' (case-insensitive) if and only if s has even length and its first half equals its second half; otherwise, the output is 'NO' (case-insensitive).
